name: soft
description: Calm, clean cues beneath a talking voice.

sounds.name: whoosh
sounds.prompt: A short soft airy non-musical UI whoosh, smooth and clean, quiet tail, suitable under calm speech.

sounds.name: click
sounds.prompt: A tiny soft dry non-musical UI click, clean transient and no echo, suitable under calm speech.

sounds.name: tick-roll
sounds.prompt: A short gentle non-musical ticking roll for a number beginning to count, clean and restrained under speech.

sounds.name: chime
sounds.prompt: A brief soft clean non-musical UI confirmation chime, subtle rounded tone with a short tail under calm speech.
